SELECT cls,
  CASE WHEN fish_date_doy<250 THEN '244-249' WHEN fish_date_doy<260 THEN '250-259' WHEN fish_date_doy<270 THEN '260-269' ELSE '270-274' END AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) n_trips, SUM(yt) sum_yt, SUM(anglers) sum_anglers, SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy>=244 AND fish_date_doy<=274 AND cls IN ('overnight','day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT avail_season, avail_doy, value
FROM climate
WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=1 AND avail_doy BETWEEN 140 AND 210
ORDER BY avail_doy;
